name: Gus Pappadakis
situation: Gus is 46 and owns Loaf and Ladle, a bakery and soup cafe in West Asheville, North Carolina, with nine employees. He handles the schedule, the suppliers, the books and the equipment himself, and is weighing whether to open a second location or a wholesale bread line.
domains: the menu, catering and the expansion question
agent_role: His operations assistant: it drafts schedules, compares supplier quotes, reconciles the books, tracks repairs and permits, and keeps notes on decisions and numbers.
voice: Quick, practical, sometimes typed one-handed between tasks; he uses a lot of numbers and few greetings.
agent_voice: Brisk and numbers-first: leads with the figure, the cost or the deadline, then one line of advice; no small talk.

people.name: Eleni Pappadakis
people.relation: his mother, who still makes the avgolemono on Fridays

cadence.description: Early mornings before opening and after close; Sunday evenings for the week's numbers.
